# Cadence demo guide

<!-- Generated by scripts/demo/record.ts (pnpm demo:record). Don't edit by hand. -->

A full trial recorded from the app itself in **demo mode**: the real screens, checks, scheduling and charts, with LinkedIn, Stripe and Claude replaced by local stand-ins.

- **Watch:** [cadence-demo.mp4](https://github.com/MAKaminski/cadence/releases/latest/download/cadence-demo.mp4) (118 s, captions burned in, plus a [WebVTT file](../public/demo/cadence-demo.vtt))
- **Try it yourself:** `pnpm demo`, then open <http://localhost:3000> and choose *Continue as demo user* ([setup](../README.md#run-it-in-two-minutes-no-keys))
- **Re-record it:** `pnpm demo:record` (Playwright drives the app; ffmpeg encodes it)

| Time | Chapter |
|---|---|
| 0:00 | Cadence: LinkedIn posts in your own voice, from two minutes a week. $20/month after a 7-day trial. |
| 0:05 | Everything is visible: 12 settings you choose once, 5 weekly actions, 11 automatic routines |
| 0:10 | Every draft is fixed, rewritten once, or held for you, by the same published rules |
| 0:15 | Sign in. Real users use LinkedIn's official sign-in; the demo uses a throwaway account |
| 0:18 | Card first, 7 days free. Real users go to Stripe Checkout; the demo takes no card |
| 0:22 | Setup 1 of 3: who you are, who you want to reach, and the only facts Cadence may state |
| 0:27 | Setup 2 of 3: three of your own posts teach it your voice, plus topics and a never-write-about list |
| 0:33 | Setup 3 of 3: posts per week, days, time, and the writing model (Claude Sonnet 5 or Opus 5) |
| 0:38 | Each week: two minutes of rough notes. That's the only regular input |
| 0:43 | Cadence writes 2 versions of each post in your voice, checks both, and keeps the better one |
| 0:48 | Drafts are ready. Nothing posts until you approve it |
| 0:51 | Why this draft: the angle, every check it passed, what was fixed automatically, and what it cost |
| 0:58 | Edit anything. Your version is re-checked but never rewritten: you're the author |
| 1:04 | Approved: the exact text is locked and scheduled into your next posting slot, in your time zone |
| 1:08 | Or post now. It goes out once through LinkedIn's official API (recorded, not sent, in the demo) |
| 1:12 | Published, with each post's latest numbers (sample numbers in demo mode until LinkedIn approves analytics) |
| 1:17 | Results. Outreach: posts per week against your target; solid bars hit it, faded bars fell short |
| 1:22 | Impact: reach (bars) and engagement rate (line) per post, a 4-post average and your best post |
| 1:27 | What works for you: engagement by angle, weekday and length. Each chart has a table view too |
| 1:32 | Settings: model use, automatic posting (after 5 clean approvals), connected assistants and API keys |
| 1:37 | API keys have read, write and a separate approve scope that only you can grant |
| 1:41 | Use Cadence from Claude, Codex, Cursor or VS Code: it's an MCP server with one-click installs |
| 1:49 | Or script it: a REST API with an OpenAPI reference, rate limits, and a CLI |
| 1:53 | Every rule is public. Run it yourself: git clone, pnpm install, pnpm demo. MIT licensed. |
